This repository is a skill pack for building Avni reports (Metabase, Superset, Jasper).
Always read `AGENTS.md` first and follow its golden rules (read-only production, patch in place, back up before writes, prove output with QA).
Then load the relevant `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`.
At the end of every task, record new learnings or corrections with `python3 tools/add_learning.py` (see `skills/report-learnings/SKILL.md`).
